title: Hold every language to the channel rules and the 256-member cap
description: Hold every language to the channel rules and the 256-member cap
no_spec_change_rationale: GROUP-8.b and GROUP-9 already require the 256-member cap and channel ownership. This change adds shared reject cases and makes every language walk them. Canonical specs do not change.
acceptance_criteria: Every language rejects a 257th member and forged channel actions from the shared delta vector.
